episodes.title: Noche de truco
episodes.summary: An eerie snowfall disrupts Juan's card night with friends. As tensions rise, they craft a suit for him to brave the storm and find his daughter.

episodes.title: Salgan al sol
episodes.summary: Salvo braves a ravaged Buenos Aires to reach Elena and Clara's apartment, discovering that human survival instincts can be as deadly as the toxic snow.

episodes.title: El magnetismo
episodes.summary: Searching Clara's school for clues, Juan and Elena meet Pablo, a student in distress. Meanwhile, Tano attempts radio contact as Juan's visions intensify.

episodes.title: Credo
episodes.summary: Tano and Juan head downtown, where they encounter a barricade and army forces. Confronted by a sudden threat, they receive help from an unexpected lot.

episodes.title: Paisaje
episodes.summary: The group heads for the island, with Tano making a tough choice to ensure passage. On the way, they discover a refugee camp inside a deserted mall.

episodes.title: Jugo de tomate frío
episodes.summary: After a risky train mission back to the city, a mysterious bright light lures Juan away, leading him to an unimaginable discovery.
